title: Adventurers' Guild
_comment: The classic four-person RPG party — tank, scout, caster, healer — rebuilt entirely from the MODERN Universal-LPC generator (split-per-animation art) so the whole party carries the expanded platformer poses (jump, climb, run, sit…) plus a battle-ready 'combat_idle' the classic combined set never had. Every layer is fetched on demand from 'remote' and composited in z-order; nothing is vendored. Each member is dressed only in pieces whose art covers the full animation set, so no pose renders half-equipped.
